tickets.title: Complete address and residency update checks
tickets.text:
Use this checklist when Lina and Rowan Thimblefern report a move or residency change:
- Confirm new mailing address, physical residence, phone number, and preferred email.
- Determine effective move date and whether the change is temporary or permanent.
- Update CRM, custodial records, planning software, billing records, and household profile as applicable.
- Check whether state residency affects tax withholding, municipal bond exposure, 529 plans, insurance, or estate documents.
- Ask whether employer benefits, Medicare, Social Security, voter registration, or driver records also need attention.
- Confirm whether any trusted contacts, beneficiaries, or household members also require address updates.
- Save written confirmation of the requested change and any submitted forms.

The Thimblefern household is moving from Colorado to Oregon, with the Bend home purchase closing in April 2025 at $895,000; update mailing records, account profiles, household assumptions, tax coordination, and trusted-contact information accordingly.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to update those records and coordination items by 2025-03-21.
